title: SelectorGroupChat example does not work with o3-mini
body:
### What happened?

SelectorGroupChat example does not work with o3-mini. The prompt we use has the agent very eager to TERMINATE after 1 round of thinking.

https://microsoft.github.io/autogen/stable//user-guide/agentchat-user-guide/selector-group-chat.html

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a332228c-7728-4643-b034-2f7f9af01643)

### What did you expect to happen?

For it to work like GPT-4o

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

Run the example, but change the model to o3-mini

### AutoGen version

0.4.5

### Which package was this bug in

AgentChat

### Model used

o3-mini

### Python version

_No response_

### Operating system

_No response_

### Any additional info you think would be helpful for fixing this bug

_No response_

linked_prs.title: doc: Update SelectorGroupChat doc on how to use O3-mini model.

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves a problem with the behavior of an LLM-based agent system when using the o3-mini model, specifically related to prompt behavior and model output handling, which are components unique to agent systems.
